disasterLayers.name: Parbati Riverbank Flash Flood Zone
disasterLayers.description: Riverbank overflow vulnerability during monsoon reservoir releases. High risk for riverside campers & tourists.
disasterLayers.safetyProtocol: Do not enter riverbed. Evacuate to higher ground if siren sounds.

disasterLayers.name: Guna Ridge Landslide Incline Sector
disasterLayers.source: Geological Survey of India / State Disaster Management
disasterLayers.description: Active slope instability along hill viewpoint access highway. Soil creep detected after heavy rains.
disasterLayers.safetyProtocol: Maintain 50m distance from cliff edges. Watch for falling debris.

blackspots.name: NH-46 Myana Blind Curve Blackspot
blackspots.riskDescription: High frequency sharp curve with poor night lighting. 14 heavy vehicle collisions recorded.
blackspots.safetyAdvice: Reduce speed to under 40 km/h. High night fog risk.
